title: 持续价格相对强势后的五日向上突破

objective.meaning: Test whether persistent observed price leadership followed by another upward breakout supplies useful evidence for the user's very-high-probability net +30 signal objective. Price leadership is not demonstrated influence over other stocks.
objective.probabilityScreenStatus: Existing assistant-proposed research screen, not an observed probability, user guarantee or sufficient acceptance criterion.

researchAccounting.thresholdMeaning: These are one fixed, falsifiable first hypothesis, not proven optimal thresholds. Do not scan nearby percentiles, drawdowns, efficiencies, breakout lengths or ranking weights and keep the best result.
researchAccounting.adaptiveResearch: The same parent rule already has inspected 2022-2023 development outcomes. This is a frozen-rule 2024-2025 replication before the already frozen repair filter, with known six-stock default-strategy prior exposure. No new threshold, seed, rank or control population is chosen from the supplemental outcomes.
researchAccounting.nextResearchScope: This first rule addresses only price-leader continuation. Continue the separately specified leaderContinuation, leaderRepair, leadershipReplacement and followerRelay research directions; this document does not replace them with one permanently fixed strategy. Each later role, group or observable-state mapping needs its own causal definition and registration.

registrationPrerequisites.pendingMeaning: The panel is complete and independently replayed. Every frozen file must match. This rule registration alone is not executable acceptance: require focused runner tests and independent review, then freeze complete source/configuration in the output protocol and execution archive before any candidate evaluation.
registrationPrerequisites.executionFreeze: Exclusive new supplemental output. Register protocol, exact explicit selection, raw snapshot identity and source archive before candidate evaluation; preserve failed output and refuse automatic restart. Successful output may only be verified.
registrationPrerequisites.preRunValidation: Require focused supplemental lifecycle/source-binding tests and independent review, then freeze unchanged method/configuration, exact explicit stock selection, source/panel/audit identities and complete execution archive before evaluating any real predicate or outcome.

sample.source: The independently audited cutoff source and supplemental feature panel on the original explicit 3141-symbol frame. No date extension beyond 2025, population substitution or current-name filter.
sample.warmupPolicy: Retain the existing 500-observed-bar source-loader warmup and full-prefix state. Feature ranks use the frozen 2023 warmup. Emit signals only in 2024-2025; no detection or active-event history is imported from the old interval.
sample.coverageLimit: This fixed local-file sample is not a certified historical whole-market universe. The 125 absent securities and the separate 56-stock completed supplementary package remain outside this fixed trial; do not append available or successful names only.

featureEvidence.clock: Read the panel row identified by (symbol,T). Its features and archived ranks use only observations at or before T. Validate contributing windows against the frozen exchange calendar; never substitute the last available bars for missing slots.
featureEvidence.priceBasis: Unadjusted security.bars and raw sh000300 observations. Do not use series.signal_bars or introduce an unverified action adjustment. This is a raw-price diagnostic, not an economic-profit or corporate-action certificate.
featureEvidence.requiredPriceObservation: For every stock and benchmark slot T-60..T: matching date/raw-unadjusted basis, finite positive OHLC with low <= min(open,close) <= max(open,close) <= high, finite positive volume and no explicit halt. Missing or invalid slots are unevaluable. Positive-volume/explicit-halt contradictions remain unknown; unknown daily status is recorded, not upgraded to verified trading.
featureEvidence.persistence: Require knownStrengthRankSessions20=20 and twenty finite archived relativeReturn20 percentiles for T-19..T with their original date-specific cross-section counts. Mean/minimum are the audited panel values; never recompute old ranks using today's eligible stocks or candidate set.
featureEvidence.rankingPopulation: The panel independently ranks each horizon across all fixed-sample rows with a finite relative return, before legacy trading qualification. Rank denominators and unknown rows remain as audited; do not rerank within base eligibility or only among candidate survivors.
featureEvidence.otherFeatures: Do not add a threshold on raw return, absolute relative return, amount ratio, MA count, theme, presumed controller, or unregistered top-quantile count. Amount and other panel descriptors may be logged without changing this rule.

baseEligibility.source: The audited panel's separately recorded as-of baseEligibility state, with the registered existing DailyScorer pools_only rules and causal prefix fallback for a full-history load rejection. It affects candidate eligibility, never feature/rank construction.
baseEligibility.listingHistorySemantics: At least 120 observed-history bars; when a listing date is supplied, the existing scorer caps observed history by elapsed calendar days since listing. This is not 120 independently verified listing calendar days.
baseEligibility.amountSemantics: Keep the existing mean of the last twenty observed bars including T, normally T-19..T. It is separate from panel prior20MeanAmount over T-20..T-1; do not swap these definitions.
baseEligibility.rejectionOrder: Use the audited panel's frozen baseEligibility label without independently changing its rule. Missing/malformed qualification, invalidHistory, missingDailyBar and notObservedYet are unevaluable. Other explicit eligible=false labels are ineligible legacy diagnostic rejections; the label alone does not prove amount20 or observedDays is independently known because the compact panel sidecar does not store those values. Preserve the exact reason and unknown fields. Required price/benchmark/panel evidence failures are unevaluable, not observed failed patterns. Record every row's predicate evidence even when it cannot become a candidate.
baseEligibility.unknownIdentity: Missing ST, membership, listing or trade-status evidence stays unknown under the explicitly diagnostic fallback. Do not fill it from current names/status, future delisting or final membership. Empty corporate-action responses never prove no events.

trigger.numericComparison: Finite Python binary floating point as emitted by the frozen feature implementation; comparisons below use the stated >=, <= or > directly, without epsilon, display rounding, threshold retuning or decimal reinterpretation. Unknown/nonfinite inputs never pass.

rawFiveSessionBreakout.missingPolicy: The current bar and all five reference bars must be valid aligned raw price observations within the complete required 61-slot window. Never replace a missing prior day or include T's high. Equality is not a breakout.

trigger.emission: At T close, emit a raw candidate exactly when base eligibility, all required evidence, all five numeric gates and the five-session breakout pass. Evaluate every date independently: no first-breakout requirement, cooldown, retest state or holding-aware detector suppression. Repeated raw triggers remain in the record.

selection.rankingMeaning: Lexicographic order over the complete same-day raw candidate set. Do not blend the two ranks into an unregistered weighted score. Any compatibility score field must not change this order.
selection.activeExclusion: Record complete ranks and select min(5,rawCandidateCount) first; only then exclude same-symbol same-group active events. Do not backfill rank six. A prior target exit at today's open releases that symbol for a new close signal.

controls.pool: Same-day base-eligible fixed-sample universe excluding the strategy's pre-active Top5; do not filter controls by candidate feature gates, future completeness, target outcomes or subsequent execution.
controls.sort: SHA256 UTF-8 of seed + ':' + T + ':' + candidateId + ':' + symbol, ascending hexadecimal digest, then symbol ascending
controls.requestedCount: The strategy's pre-active Top5 count on T
controls.shortfalls: Log pool size, requested/matched count, selected symbols and shortfall. No replacement after active exclusion or failed entry.
controls.interpretation: Descriptive same-day base-pool comparison only. Independent active suppression breaks date pairing; shared market/security episodes are correlated, and this is not randomized causal evidence.

eventPolicy.implementation: Reuse the frozen SignalTargetStudy and PathRiskStudy execution/observation rules; freeze their complete dependencies and configuration at registration.
eventPolicy.capitalMeaning: Independent notional events, not one simultaneously funded portfolio or a portfolio-return estimate.
eventPolicy.entry: At T close freeze the lot-rounded quantity from T close, the existing nominal next-session price-limit reserve, fees and T volume participation cap. Attempt only T+1 exchange-session open; never enlarge an order using T+1 price/volume or defer an unfilled order.
eventPolicy.feePolicyMeaning: These are unchanged numerical assumptions of the frozen research engine, not a claim that every historical fee or auction execution has been independently certified. Preserve original limit/halt/missing/opening-capacity gates and later capacity audits.
eventPolicy.sellLock: No sale on entry day; the earliest sellable observation is the following exchange session.
eventPolicy.targetDenominator: Actual invested capital: filled quantity times entry fill price plus buy fees. Uninvested event cash is separate, not included in the position-level +30 denominator.
eventPolicy.primaryOutcome: nextOpenNet30: first sell-eligible full-position opening proxy whose proceeds after sell fees divided by invested capital minus one is at least 0.30, under the unchanged engine's finite comparison and execution gates.
eventPolicy.cutoff: Observe through 2025-12-31's last registered exchange session. Keep unhit events, marks, data gaps and right-censoring; not hit by cutoff is not permanent failure. No 2026 observations.
eventPolicy.knownEngineLimit: The reused gate conservatively blocks a resumption opening after a known preceding halt. No correction or relaxation is introduced inside this comparative candidate.

auditAndEvaluation.evaluationPopulation: Every original fixed symbol on each of the 485 target sessions: 3141 × 485 = 1523385 predicate rows. Preserve ineligible, unevaluable, observed nontriggering and raw-triggering rows; retain failed lookalikes.
auditAndEvaluation.logs: Retain daily coverage, all raw candidates and predicate values, archived-rank evidence and denominators, exact six breakout bars, full candidate ranking, Top5, control matching, selected signals, active suppression, all attempted events and all filled/unfilled/censored outcomes. Bind each row to frozen panel/source hashes.
auditAndEvaluation.cohortRule: For each horizon, maturity uses potential calendar followup from entry, not early target success. Entry day is held session one; suspended sessions still count in the potential exchange-calendar followup. Missing-data and capacity audits stop at the earlier of the horizon and the main target exit, but an early hit cannot admit an otherwise immature recent event. Report denominator, valid-data subset, data-missing bounds and insufficient followup separately. Horizons have different cohorts and are not one unconditional cumulative probability curve.
auditAndEvaluation.timeToTarget: Report observed first-hit session counts and their distribution together with unhit/right-censored counts. A median among successful events alone is not an expected waiting time or eventual success probability.
auditAndEvaluation.pathRule: Observe raw daily lows relative to entry fill, including entry-day T+1-locked risk. At a target opening exit use the exit observation and exclude that day's later low and all later prices. Report target without observed boundary, boundary then target, boundary still waiting, neither observed and data unresolved, at every fixed horizon and cutoff. These are not stop orders or realized net liquidation losses.
auditAndEvaluation.dependence: Report distinct symbols, dates and repeated market episodes. Do not treat overlapping events as independent evidence; existing independent-observation confidence intervals are descriptive only.
auditAndEvaluation.failurePolicy: Retain all failed/unfilled/unknown/censored cases and immutable failed attempts. Zero or sparse candidates is a possible falsifying/insufficient-evidence result, not permission to relax thresholds or change the sample.
auditAndEvaluation.decisionBoundary: Supplemental historical raw-price evidence only; no future high-probability, historical full-market, economic-rights or executable-liquidity certification. Preserve results of the frozen parent and controls before applying the separately frozen repair rule; no threshold tuning.
auditAndEvaluation.postRun: Independently check registration and source hashes, panel linkage, causal predicates and five-bar breakout, full ranking/control selection, no-backfill active replay, next-session entry, fees, target/path timing and all cohort counts. Do not overwrite completed output or silently rerun a changed success.

nonClaims: No claim of identified controllers, manipulation, institutional positions or market-moving causal leadership.
No verified theme/industry grouping, follower influence, adaptive market-state policy or optimal threshold selection.
This parent candidate already has prior development results; this new supplemental run has not executed at registration. No new independent net30 probability or pristine holdout is claimed.

designSource.change: Original candidate ID, trigger thresholds, ranking, deterministic controls, active/event policy and fee assumptions retained; only the explicitly registered supplementary input interval/source and corresponding cutoff change.

executionReviewPolicy.sourceFreeze: Freeze the final rule, runner and full transitive source dependencies, normalized configuration and panel binding in a protocol and source archive before evaluating any real row. Check for source/input drift before completing; a changed executable or configuration requires separately versioned registration, never a success rerun.
executionReviewPolicy.failedAttemptPolicy: Preserve every failed attempt and partial output. Unchanged-protocol technical recovery may create another numbered attempt only after the coordinator diagnoses the terminal failure and records what outcomes were already observable; never retry automatically, restart after a mere polling timeout, or choose the best attempt. Completed output may only be verified, never recomputed.

fixedPopulation.meaning: The original frozen survivor-biased local sample; no historical whole-market membership certification.

downstreamPolicy.activePositions: Start each parent/control/filtered group empty at first 2024 signal day, retain across the 2025 boundary, no stop/expiry or forced cutoff sale.
downstreamPolicy.featureMethods: Existing frozen raw leadership features/ranks and base-eligibility logic remain unchanged; loader retains its existing 500 observed-bar causal warmup state. Feature rank calendar begins 2023-01-01.
downstreamPolicy.outcomes: All seven frozen horizons, cutoff waiting and adverse paths required; no 2026 prices appended. Rules and constants cannot be chosen using this interval results.
downstreamPolicy.targetPeriod: 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31; market role history begins on first 2024 target session and first ten repair-gate days remain unknown, matching development startup.

runPolicy.signalSource: Audited feature panel and raw source only; no market observation or candidate-outcome filter is added to the parent.
